sites.title: The Old Lighthouse
sites.intro: Salt wind has worn the lighthouse down, and its lamp has been dark for a long time. Ships of light once found the isles by its glow.
sites.complete_text: The great lamp catches, turns, and throws its warm beam over the sea. Somewhere far away, a Hearthstone answers with a glow.

steps.title: Mend the door
steps.done_text: The door swings open on a spiral of old stairs.

steps.title: Repair the stairs
steps.done_text: Step by step, the stairs are safe again, all the way to the lamp room.

steps.title: Fit a sea-glass lens
steps.done_text: The new lens glitters in every sea color.

steps.title: Relight the lamp
steps.done_text: Resin and glowcaps make a slow, gentle flame.

sites.title: The Old Mountain Path
sites.intro: Rocks have fallen across the only pass up to the Frostbloom Highlands. With a climbing rope you could reach the top of the rockfall and clear the way.
sites.complete_text: The rocks are cleared and new steps lead up the pass. Cool, snowy air drifts down from the highlands.

steps.title: Anchor your climbing rope above the rocks
steps.done_text: The rope holds fast. You can reach the top of the rockfall now.

steps.title: Roll the loose rocks aside
steps.done_text: With a few branches as levers, the loose rocks roll gently aside.

steps.title: Lay new wooden steps
steps.done_text: Sturdy steps lead up into the snow.
